description: Application under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act for a 'non-material amendment' to Condition 1 (approved drawings/documents) for design changes to Plot G (including changes to the residential mix; creation of additional residential space previously identified for plant; revised front entrance and canopy and revised top-level plant area) and 'Belfour Place' landscaping of reserved matters approval dated 2nd June 2021 reference 2019/2325.
